name: Li-ion Battery Separators & Cell Materials Localisation
scope: India's ACC/gigafactory build-out (Exide Energy Solutions commissioned 6 GWh Phase-I on 23 Sep 2026) needs separator film, anode, electrolyte and binder that are largely imported from China; TCPL Packaging's board approved a Rs 125 cr separator-film entry on 11 Aug 2026 (subsidiary incorporated 24 Sep), which is still barely covered, while the anode/electrolyte names (Himadri, Gujarat Fluorochem, Graphite India) are already partly discovered and have re-rated (Himadri ~+50% in 1 year, GFL ~+43% in 6 months) so the separator niche is the earliest leg.
questions: What is a lithium-ion battery separator film (wet-process polyolefin, coated variants), why is it a critical cell material, and how large and fast-growing is global and Indian demand as ACC cell capacity comes online?
How concentrated is global separator, anode, electrolyte and binder supply (China, Japan, Korea), and how import-dependent are Indian cell makers today?

What did TCPL Packaging announce (Rs 125 cr, 70 million sq m initial capacity, Q4 FY28 start, 500 million sq m long-term, wholly-owned TCPL Energy Materials), which technology and customers are secured, and how credible is execution for a packaging company?

What are Himadri Speciality Chemical (anode plant commissioned Apr 2026, LFP cathode plans) and Graphite India (Rs 4,330 cr synthetic graphite anode board approval) actually doing, and what are their timelines, qualification status and funding?
What is Gujarat Fluorochemicals' real battery-chemicals revenue (LiPF6, electrolyte, PVDF, LFP cathode), and how material is it to the group?
Which Indian cell makers (Exide Energy, Amara Raja, Ola, Reliance and others) are the likely domestic customers, and what are their commissioning schedules and sourcing plans?
Which other listed Indian companies (small or mid cap) have announced separator, coating, electrolyte-additive or other cell-material plans that were missed here?
What policy support (ACC-PLI, ECMS, customs duty, localisation rules) helps these materials plants, and what are the subsidy timelines?
Has the market already priced this in: stock performance over 1, 6 and 12 months for each name, valuation, and the extent of broker and mainstream media coverage grouping these stocks?

What are the key risks (Chinese price competition, qualification delays, capex and leverage, cell-maker demand slippage, technology shifts such as sodium-ion) and what near-term catalysts (qualification wins, offtake MoUs, commissioning, quarterly updates) should be monitored?

separator_films: Listed companies building lithium-ion battery separator film capacity
anode_materials: Synthetic graphite and other anode/cathode active material makers for cells
electrolyte_chemicals: LiPF6, electrolyte, binder and related fluorochemical battery inputs
